## History

Roger Pye is mentioned in connection to the Village Improvement Society's hall project in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Following the completion of the painting work by [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), the hall is mistakenly painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Despite the initial devastation felt by the society members, the mishap ultimately earns them widespread sympathy from the local community.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +25 more_
